N1-1-repeat.note: Identifies the absent mousedown binding as the premise needed to connect #down to selection.

N1-1-on-demand.note: Identifies the fresh mousedown bubbling to the bar and clearing suppression before activation emits selection.

N1-2-repeat.note: Distinguishes evidence of activation from the missing link that would make a fresh pointer press invoke #down.

N1-2-on-demand.note: Identifies #finishDrag() clearing suppression during the new mousedown before #activate emits selection.

N1-3-on-demand.note: Distinguishes the fresh item mousedown and clears suppression before tabs.ts emits selection for the unmodified click.

N1-3-repeat.note: Leaves dispatch unresolved because the evidence omits the listener binding and target.

N2-1-repeat.note: Describes retention at mousedown and consumption before dispatch. The cited sources do not prove the mousedown binding.

N2-1-on-demand.note: Places retention at the fresh mousedown and describes consumeClick clearing the flag while blocking dispatch.

N2-2-repeat.note: Describes retention and the early return but assumes that the fresh mousedown invokes #down.

N2-2-on-demand.note: Explains that the fresh mousedown and mouseup keep suppression set until the click is consumed before dispatch.

N2-3-on-demand.note: Describes retention on the fresh mousedown and the true return from consumeClick that blocks selection.

N2-3-repeat.note: Describes retention before the early return. The viewport and listener evidence is missing.
